size.description: Volume size, capped at 5Gi. Every replicated storage class puts a full copy on each node it spans, out of a 20Gi data disk per dev-cluster node shared with every other volume.

class.description: StorageClass. Both are DRBD-replicated; the number is the replica count.

cpu.description: CPU request, capped at 500m — a quarter of a dev-cluster worker's 2 vCPUs.

memory.description: Memory request, capped at 1Gi — a third of a dev-cluster worker's 3Gi.
